issues_encountered: uart_controller RX mis-frames back-to-back 8N1 bytes (returns to idle only at end of stop bit, falls one oversample tick behind per byte; fails after ~7 bytes); first misdiagnosed as the CPU being too slow
dcache_inval (CSR 0x7C1) discards dirty lines: a volatile C spin counter between flush and inval rolled back stack frames and hung the CRC command
bitwise vs nibble-table CRC made no difference to rx rate; MMIO reads dominate
backdoor SRAM read after WRITE sees zeros: bytes sit in the write-back D$ until flushed
fixes_applied: host tool and cocotb UART model send 8N2 (uart_load.py --stopbits 2 default); RTL fix left to the RTL owner
flush+inval in one register-only asm block
tests read the SRAM backdoor only after the CRC command (which flushes)
notes: Scoped step (bead hlrm.2 boot item), not a full firmware flow. PR #307 draft. soc_all_ci NOT RUN: a librelane process was still running (host-memory rule). Sim runs at ~1.2k cycles/s under PD load, so keep payloads small. TESTCASE=a,b runs a subset of soc_uart_boot.
